article.headline: Sandfort scores 20 to lead Nebraska over Le Moyne 106-64 in opener
article.description: — Pryce Sandfort scored 20 points for Nebraska, Cale Jacobsen added 16 and the Cornhuskers rolled past Le Moyne 106-64 on Monday night in a season opener.
article.linkText: Sandfort scores 20 to lead Nebraska over Le Moyne 106-64 in opener
article.story: LINCOLN, Neb. -- — Pryce Sandfort scored 20 points for Nebraska, Cale Jacobsen added 16 and the Cornhuskers rolled past Le Moyne 106-64 on Monday night in a season opener. Sandfort shot 7 of 13 from the field and matched a team-high with five rebounds. Jacobsen made both his 3-point attempts and finished 7 of 8 overall from the floor. Connor Essegian added 13 points for Nebraska. Damon Wilkinson and Jacob Lanier each chipped in with 11 points. Wilkinson made all nine of his free-throw attempts and had one of the Cornhuskers' four blocks. It was tied 17-all with 12:43 remaining before Nebraska pulled away for a 58-32 lead at the break. The Cornhuskers shot 54% overall from the field, made 13 of their 30 3-pointers and forced 17 turnovers in the first meeting between the programs. Trevor Roe made five 3-pointers and scored 20 points to lead Le Moyne. Jayden Teat scored 14 points. The Dolphins returned just two letterwinners from last year -- reserves Roe and Josiah Lee — and added 13 newcomers, including 10 Division I transfers. Nebraska extended its school-record to 23 consecutive regular-season, non-conference wins dating to Nov. 22, 2024. Up next Le Moyne: At Creighton on Thursday. Nebraska: Plays Providence in the Basketball Hall of Fame Tip-Off at Mohegan Sun Arena on Saturday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
